notes: Workshop, amber: a print bed with a gantry beam; the print head slides along it and the beam walks across as a part builds up under it (hot newest layer). A violet filament spool on the left, amber lamps and a violet lamp on the right. Damaged: the bed is cracked, the beam is bent and the head hangs off at an angle spitting sparks. Disabled: the head has fallen onto the bed, the beam is snapped, the part has collapsed to rubble.
